text_block_list.text:
On the training course, Hishi Amazon
was checking the fit of her adjusted racing outfit—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Alright!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Everything's on point, down to the finest detail!
Flawless work, Trainy!
Come to think of it, I asked her if she had designed her racing Racers suit herself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's right.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Actually, there's a bit of behind-the-scenes trivia—a little story, if you will.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: In a sailor uniform!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
"I've received your racewear motif request.
Do you have any specific preferences for the design details?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! When it comes to me in a sailor uniform,
you can pretty much guess the vibe, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Yes...! That action movie I watched
on the plane to Japan when I was a kid—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(A black sailor suit just like the protagonist's
in 'Fighting Spirit! Sukeban Chronicles.'
It's perfect for me!)

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I will tailor it with all my heart and soul.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, looks like it's finally finished.
Let's see how good it is right away—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Huh?! T-This design isn't so much
"delinquent" as it is...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"So yeah, instead of a delinquent sailor uniform,
it ended up being a legit marine-style outfit."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it turned out great in the end, thinking back,
it really was an absurdly vague order, wasn't it?"
choice_data_list: Still, I'm glad you liked it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! With this, I can go toe-to-toe
against anyone on the track—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Wait!
Th-that's right...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"A new victory pose to go with this racing attire!
I was just in the middle of coming up with one!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The Winning Live is a serious match too, after all.
It'd be better to have a pose that matches this outfit, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! So with that said,
you're hanging out with me now, Trainy!

Led by Hishi Amazon, I ended up
practicing a performance on the outdoor stage.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's get fired up and strike a pose.
Let's try out a bunch of different ones!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right away, why don't you tell me something
that'd go well with this racing outfit, Trainer-boy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So it's to match the design, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright then—with style!
How does this look?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, is that so, is that so!
Looks like we might already have a winner here♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—All right! In that case, let's play the sailor's part
to absolute perfection!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Look, if you want to solidify the image,
getting into character is the fastest way, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm used to playing pretend with the little ones!
I'll show ya just how into the groove Big Sis Hishiama can get!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Aircraft Carrier spotted at two o'clock!
This ship is initiating a charge—let's settle this one-on-one!!"
choice_data_list: Wait, I'm playing the enemy carrier!?
I'm playing the role of the enemy aircraft carrier?!

text_block_list.text:
Afterward... going along with Hishi Amazon
who got super into researching poses,
we spent some time playing... sailors?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see, so we're incorporating the initial
'black sailor uniform' image as well, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Squat down like this,
and maybe glare real mean-like while I'm at it—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You wanna go, huh, punk?!
Ahaha, just kidding... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Unyaa~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A-A kitten rubbed up against me...
Did a stray wander onto the academy grounds, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You strike such an intimidating pose, yet you're telling me you aren't afraid of me at all?

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Nyaan♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what a fearless one!
Getting all friendly with big sis Hishi Ama, who could make a crying child shut right up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: W-Well... whatever. Follow me, kitty! If you're starving, I'll whip something up for ya!

...In the end, Hishi Amazon decided
to take care of the kitten.
